book.name: Isikiyel
book.title: Isikiyel Isikiyel Bin Gibit Wed Brom God Deya Langa Bebalon

content: YAWEI tok adbalawei blanga ol detlot drimin sheip
Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin kipgon tok langa mi,
“Isikiyel, yu luk langa ol dislot hil kantri langa Isreil en yu garra dalim olabat main mesij.

Yu garra dalim detlot hil kantri langa Isreil blanga irrim main wed. Mi na YAWEI det boswan God, en mi tok langa ola haiwan hil, en langa ola beli. Ai garra binijimap detlot pleis weya detlot pipul oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip.

Detlot enamimob garra bitsimap ol detlot teibul blanga ofring blanga detlot drimin sheip en ol detlot pleis weya detlot pipul oldei barnimbat ola gudsmelwan medisin blanga detlot drimin sheip en nobodi kaan go langa olabat enimo. Ola pipul garra gitkil deya lida langa olabat drimin sheip.
Ai garra spredimat ola dedwan bodi blanga detlot Isreil pipul ebriweya. Ai garra spredimat olabat boun olaran langa detlot teibul blanga ofring weya dei oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip.

Detlot enamimob garra bitsimap ol detlot taun langa Isreil en ol detlot drimin sheip, en ol detlot teibul blanga ofring, en detlot teibul weya deibin oldei barnimbat det gudsmelwan medisin, en ol detlot ebrijing garra ol binij.
Pipul garra gitkil ebriweya en detlot pipul hu jidan laibala garra sabi mi na YAWEI det trubala God.
“Bat ai garra larram sambala pipul jidan laibala en olabat garra jidan langa najawan kantri,

weya olabat garra jidan prisana. Deya na olabat garra jinggabat mi na en sabi aibin panishim olabat en meigim olabat brabli sheim miselp, dumaji deibin oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip. Olabat garra brabli sheim miselp du, dumaji deibin dumbat detlot brabli nogudbala ting.
En olabat garra sabi mi na YAWEI det trubala God, en wen aibin wonimbat olabat, ai nomo bin dalimbat laiyawan wed.

“Isikiyel, yu garra jingat nogudbalawei dumaji detlot Isreil pipul bin dum brabli nogudbala ting. Dei garra dai. Sambala garra dai langa wo, en sambala brom jidanbat hanggriwan, en sambala brom siknis.

Detlot pipul hu jidan longwei garra dai brom nogudwan siknis en detlot pipul hu jidan gulijap garra gitkil langa wo, en detlot hu stil jidan laibala garra dai dumaji dei nomo garram eni daga. Dei garra sabi mi brabli wail langa olabat.

Ola ded bodi garra spredat ebriweya weya olabat bin oldei weshipbat detlot drimin sheip. Deibin weship olabat langa ebri haibala hil, en andanith langa ola sheidiwan tri, en olaran langa detlot drimin sheip en langa ebri teibul blanga ofring weya deibin meigim sekrifais langa detlot drimin sheip. Wal ai garra kipgon dumbat lagijat raidap mi sedisfaid, dumaji mi brabli wail langa olabat.

Lagijat na ai garra dum. Ai garra pudumat main bingga en ai garra panishim ola pipul en ai garra meigim olabat kantri jidan rabishwan brom det deset kantri langa sauthsaid raidap langa det taun gulum Ribla langa nowathwei. Ai kaan libum eni pleis gudwan weya ola Isreil pipul oldei jidan. Afta tharran ebribodi garra sabi mi na YAWEI det boswan God.”
